Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TechConnect Solutions specializes in retail and service of cellular phones, offering a wide range of products including the latest smartphone models, accessories, and certified repair services. Our operations include sales of both new and refurbished devices, as well as in-store and online repairs for various phone brands. We prioritize customer satisfaction through high-quality service and strict adherence to data protection standards, ensuring the security of sensitive customer information during transactions and repairs. Our team is trained to handle customer inquiries efficiently, and we implement inventory management protocols to mitigate risks of theft and loss. We actively monitor industry trends to adapt our offerings and maintain a competitive edge in the market.
